verdict.rationale: Spline's own MCP Server lets AI clients drive the open editor programmatically. The AI Agent also works 'through the editor itself' to create objects, materials, lighting, animation and interactivity, which suggests broad editor coverage. However, the MCP route is bundled only in the desktop app, the Code API controls exported runtime scenes rather than authoring, and probes found no public OpenAPI/REST spec, so UI parity is undocumented. Missing for 10: documented full API/UI parity, a public REST or OpenAPI editor/file API, browser-accessible programmatic access beyond the desktop MCP bundle, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Spline MCP Server — drive Spline from Claude, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients, straight into your open editor tab.
The MCP server is bundled in the desktop app, so connecting Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Antigravity or ChatGPT to your editor only works here
It enables you to trigger actions, modify object properties, and create dynamic, responsive 3D environments directly from your existing code and user interface.
